purpose: Route acquisition traffic into the existing VAYQUO product context without changing legacy app routes or core recommendation logic.
hardRules: Never rename or replace the existing internal check route.
Never modify the flight form or benefit logic from acquisition routing.
Never bypass authentication or auth-pending state.
Never prefill personal data, balances, travel searches or free text from URL parameters.
Only allow predefined entry IDs and predefined sources.
Acquisition context may influence entry destination, never recommendation ranking.
Unknown or malformed acquisition parameters must fall back to normal app startup.
